name: lodash-clone-isdeep-mooring
behavioral_change: lodash 4.0.0 removed the `isDeep` parameter of `_.clone`, so `_.clone(args, true)` performs only a shallow clone in v_new; deep cloning moved to `_.cloneDeep`. The function name and call form are unchanged.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (mooring) implements its `immutable` option by deep cloning the argument array at three sites in `index.js`; after the upgrade nested objects are shared, middleware writes leak back to the caller, and four assertions fail (for example `expected 'A' to equal 'burger'`). The production frames point at `index.js` lines 20, 98 and 118 (callback forwarding), not at the clone sites on lines 38, 46 and 68, and lodash, `clone` and `isDeep` never appear in the output.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes the three `_.clone(args, true)` calls in `index.js` (lines 38, 46 and 68) to `_.cloneDeep(args)`, leaving the intentional shallow `_.clone(args)` on line 75 untouched.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), section Compatibility Warnings, states that the `isDeep` params were removed from `_.clone` and `_.flatten`. Tier 2: prose only; the `_.cloneDeep(x)` form is derived by comparing the v3 `_.clone` and v4 `_.cloneDeep` jsdoc.
